standing.title: Standing Athletic Stance
standing.general: Hinge at hips, soft knees, chest at 45 degrees, neutral spine.
standing.ballContact: Pound the ball down; do not slap with loose fingers.

seated.title: Seated Lumbar-Deload
seated.general: Sit on the front edge of a firm chair, tall neutral spine, zero back load.
seated.ballContact: Pure wrist and forearm snap; isolate arm mechanics without leaning forward.

drills.name: Fingertip Ball Taps
drills.seatedAdaptation: Perform at chest height with tall spine; zero lower back tension.

drills.name: Around-the-Body Wraps
drills.seatedAdaptation: Wrap around head, chest, and behind chair backrest without slouching.

drills.name: Right-Hand Ankle Pounding
cues: Pound foam with sharp wrist snap
drills.seatedAdaptation: Dribble outside right chair leg, forearm parallel to floor.

drills.name: Left-Hand Ankle Pounding
cues: Athletic hip hinge, no rounded spine
drills.seatedAdaptation: Dribble outside left chair leg, isolate weak-side wrist snap.

drills.name: Right-Hand Side Pocket Pounds
cues: Pull back, push forward, no carry
drills.seatedAdaptation: Work ball strictly along chair flank; keep elbow tucked.

drills.name: Left-Hand Side Pocket Pounds
cues: Pull back, push forward, no carry
drills.seatedAdaptation: Work ball along left chair flank; activate left lat and forearm.

drills.name: High-to-Low Accordion (Right)
drills.seatedAdaptation: Drop low bounce beside right caster/foot, rise only to chest height.

drills.name: High-to-Low Accordion (Left)
drills.seatedAdaptation: Drop low bounce beside left caster/foot; do not bend forward at waist.

drills.name: Tight V-Dribble (Front)
drills.seatedAdaptation: Bounce directly between open knees; focus on snappy lateral wrist angles.

drills.name: 2-Pound + Crossover
drills.seatedAdaptation: Pound wide outside thighs, snap cross through center gap.

drills.name: Crossover with Shift
drills.seatedAdaptation: Shift shoulder and head lean side-to-side while hips stay grounded on chair.

drills.name: Off-Hand Wall-Tap Isolation
drills.seatedAdaptation: Tap desk, chair back, or wall beside you while maintaining low ankle dribble.

drills.name: Alternating Ankle Pounds (60s Right / 60s Left)
drills.seatedAdaptation: Dribble outside chair legs; isolate wrists with tall posture.

drills.name: Alternating Side Pocket (60s Right / 60s Left)
drills.seatedAdaptation: Linear push-pull beside hips, avoiding backrest contact.

drills.name: Low Rapid V-Crossovers
drills.seatedAdaptation: Keep bounce low between feet in front of chair base.

drills.name: 1-Pound Rapid Cross
drills.seatedAdaptation: One pound outside knee, quick snap cross below knees.

drills.name: Continuous Rhythmic Crossovers
drills.seatedAdaptation: Continuous ankle-height crossover with spine fully neutral.

drills.name: Accordion Dribbles (Alternating Hands)
drills.seatedAdaptation: Alternate 3 high / 3 low reps per hand outside chair perimeter.

drills.name: Figure-8 / Seated Leg Weave
drills.seatedAdaptation: Seated Single-Leg Underpass: elevate one thigh slightly to snap under, then switch.

drills.name: Free Flow / Freestyle
drills.seatedAdaptation: Freestyle combo outside legs and through center without rising off seat.
